Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a registry of methamphetamine offenders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to registration of methamphetamine offenders; andadding a new section to chapter 9A.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) There is created within the Washington state patrol aregistry of persons convicted after the effective date of this act ofa violation of RCW 69.50.401(2)(b), 69.50.440, or 69.50.406. (b) This registry shall be maintained by the Washington statepatrol and made available for public inquiry on the internet. (c) The registry shall consist of the person's name, date of birth,offense or offenses making the person eligible for inclusion on theregistry, the conviction date and county of those offenses, and otheridentifying data as the Washington state patrol determines is necessaryto properly identify the person, but shall not include the person'ssocial security number. (2) On and after the effective date of this act, the court clerksshall forward a copy of the judgment and date of birth of all personswho are convicted of a violation of the offenses described in p. 1 HB 1754subsection (1)(a) of this section to the Washington state patrol. Theinformation shall be forwarded to the Washington state patrol withinfortyfive days of the date of judgment. (3) Upon a petition by a person listed in the registry, theWashington state patrol shall remove from the registry the name andother identifying information of the person if more than seven yearshave passed since the date of the most recent qualifying convictionunder subsection (1)(a) of this section. (4) Any person required to register under this section shall followall of the requirements applicable to kidnapping offenders under RCW9A.44.130.
